description: This PHP source file 'searchMgmt.php' is part of the TestLink open source project. It manages search functionalities, including initializing arguments, environment setup, and processing search requests, with functions for handling search parameters, user rights, and rendering search results.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments, retrieves test project info, and user/session data.

methods.name: initializeEnv
methods.description: Sets up environment, including user rights and GUI parameters.

methods.name: processSearch
methods.description: Handles the search process, prepares search results, and renders the search results template.

methods.name: getSearchSkeleton
methods.description: Creates and returns a basic search skeleton object.
